rows.english: Earlier versions of Nexus could put the confirmation of one contact, from LoTW, eQSL or QRZ, or the mark that LoTW holds its upload, on another contact with the same station, band and mode on the same UTC day. Check downloads your whole history once from each of these services you have set up, which can take several minutes for LoTW, and lists each contact holding a confirmation or upload mark that the service’s own records give another contact, or none. A line starts ticked only when those records decide it. Nothing changes until you press the button, nothing is uploaded, and no paper card is touched.
rows.chinese: 旧版 Nexus 可能会把 LoTW、eQSL 或 QRZ 对某条交信的确认，或 LoTW 的上传标记，错误地记到同一 UTC 日期内电台、频段和模式相同的另一条交信上。点击“检查”会从已配置的各项服务下载完整历史记录；LoTW 可能需要几分钟。随后会列出服务记录显示确认或上传标记实际属于其他交信、或无法匹配到交信的记录。只有证据足以判定时，条目才会默认勾选。点击更改按钮前不会修改任何内容，不会上传数据，也不会更改纸质卡片的记录。
rows.previous: Nexus的早期版本可以确认一个联系人  LoTW , (中文).  eQSL  或  QRZ ,或者标记  LoTW  保持上传,在同一站、带和模式上的另一个联系人上传  UTC  日报. 请检查access-date=中的日期值 (帮助)  LoTW ,并列出持有确认或上传标记的每个联系人,即服务处自己的记录能提供另一个联系人,或者没有。 只有这些记录决定了才开始排行。 除非按下按钮,否则任何变化都不会改变,任何变化都不会上传,纸牌也不会被触碰.

rows.english: Use this if you imported a log you'd already uploaded to LoTW another way (Ham2K Polo, TQSL…). It marks the {{formatted}} un-uploaded QSO as already on LoTW, so the Upload to LoTW count stops offering to re-send them. It only updates Nexus's own record — nothing is sent, and your LoTW account and log are untouched. New QSOs you make later still upload normally.
rows.chinese: 如果导入的日志已通过其他工具（如 Ham2K Polo、TQSL）上传到 LoTW，可使用此功能。它会将 {{formatted}} 条待上传 QSO 标记为已在 LoTW 上传，上传到 LoTW的待上传数量也会相应减少。此操作只更新 Nexus 的本地标记，不会发送数据，也不会更改 LoTW 账号或在线日志。之后新增的交信仍会正常上传。
rows.previous: 如果您导入了您已经上传到的日志, 请使用此选项 LoTW 另一种方式(Ham2K Polo, TQSL . (......) (中文(简体) ). 它标志着 {{formatted}} 未装入 QSO 已经 LoTW ,所以请 上传到 LoTW 停止提供 重新发送。 它只更新了Nexus自己的记录——什么也没有寄出去,还有你 LoTW 账户和日志没有被更改。 新设 QSOs 之后仍然正常上传。

rows.english: This permanently deletes all {{count}} contact from your local logbook and rewrites the ADIF file to empty. It does not remove anything you've already uploaded to LoTW, QRZ, eQSL, or ClubLog. There is no undo — export an ADIF backup first if you might want it.

rows.english: This permanently deletes all {{count}} contacts from your local logbook and rewrites the ADIF file to empty. It does not remove anything you've already uploaded to LoTW, QRZ, eQSL, or ClubLog. There is no undo — export an ADIF backup first if you might want it.
rows.chinese: 这会从本地日志中永久删除 全部 {{count}} 条交信记录，并将 ADIF 文件清空。此操作不会删除已上传到 LoTW、QRZ、eQSL 或 ClubLog 的内容，且无法撤销。若之后可能需要这些记录，请先导出 ADIF 备份。

rows.english: It also resets your LoTW and eQSL sync position, so the next sync re-downloads your whole confirmation history instead of only recent matches. That is what brings your confirmations back after a purge — but it takes considerably longer than a routine sync, so give it time to finish.
rows.chinese: 这还会重置 LoTW 和 eQSL 的同步位置，所以下次同步会重新下载完整的确认历史，而不只是最近的匹配记录。这样可以在清空日志后恢复确认信息，但耗时会比日常同步长很多，请耐心等待完成。

rows.english: When the contact ENDED (ADIF TIME_OFF), as a 24-hour UTC time on the date of the contact. A time earlier than the start means it ran past midnight. Blank leaves the stored end time alone — it cannot be cleared here.
rows.chinese: 交信结束时间（ADIF TIME_OFF）：填写交信日期对应的 24 小时制 UTC 时间。若结束时间早于开始时间，表示交信持续到了午夜之后。留空会保留已保存的结束时间，不能在此处清除。
rows.previous: 交信结束时间（ADIF TIME_OFF）：填写交信日期对应的 24 小时制 UTC 时间。若结束时间早于开始时间，表示交信持续到了午夜之后。留空会保留已保存的结束时间，不能在此处清除。
